intro: Lesson 11: Washing hands: water only or soap and water?. Listen, look, then do the tasks with a grown-up.

panels.title: Our question
points: Water only, or soap and water?

parts.label: Why it works
parts.text: Most of the glitter is gone

panels.title: Clean for prayer
points: Wudu washes hands, face, arms and feet
Allah loves those who keep clean

keywords.def: it helps lift dirt and germs off skin
say what is the same and what is different

questions.q: What is the one thing we change?
How long do we rub our hands?
Core: With an adult, do the test: glitter on, wash with water only for 20 seconds, look; glitter on again, wash with soap and water for 20 seconds, look. Record a lot, some or none left.
questions.a: Water only: some or a lot left; soap and water: little or none left

questions.q: Extend: Write a sentence: 'Soap and water is better because...'
questions.a: ...it removes more glitter, so it removes more germs

questions.q: Stretch: When should we wash our hands?
questions.a: Before eating, after the toilet, after sneezing, before wudu
B) Soap and water. Soap lifts the glitter and germs off the skin; water alone leaves more behind.

questions.q: We should rub hands with soap for:
Big question: is water on its own enough?
questions.a: No, soap and water removes more germs
